title: 方昕中文
intro: 你好, welcome to my mandarin study guide. These are the daily tasks I do to help improve my skills.

items.name: Flashcards
items.description: A collection of sets I've curated and a few I've found online from other students. Track how well you know each card on the [Sets](/sets) page. Some of these flashcards are also available in [PDF form](https://github.com/pjflanagan/study-mandarin/tree/gh-pages/print) and on a [Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/fcmppkiemgfolnabclbilaodngmhfghf).

items.name: Lists
items.description: View any of the flashcard sets as one long list.

items.name: 唱歌
items.description: Follow along with song lyrics in Chinese with toggleable pinyin and hover-to-reveal English translations. See more on [Google Docs](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1axMQBMYX7Rk4quZHPtHFPWvlqEIqbFyj?usp=share_link) or listen to [the Spotify playlist](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7636wPWQfSQ2UXZ6Lj9Mn9?si=56c81ab3fd9b4c6f).

items.name: 注音 Trainer
items.description: Randomly pick a character and display only the zhuyin to practice reading. You can also study up with the [zhuyin chart](https://flanny.app/study-mandarin/page/zhuyin-chart/).

items.name: 讀 Tool
items.description: Type or copy/paste text to see pinyin and zhuyin, reformats to traditional.

about.title: 我是
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Peter and I've been studying mandarin for a few years now. Every now and again I find it helpful to build a little web tool to help me practice something. These tools are free for anyone to use.
about.disclaimer: * These tools were built by a student, not a native speaker. There may be errors. Characters often default to the most common pronunciation which may not be correct in all contexts.
